integrity: Proof reduces the threefold-symmetry class using established harmonic-representation tools, then supplies an exact nonzero seven-by-seven rational measurement determinant and a minimality kernel construction. All finite symbolic identities are reproducible in verify.py. Generality and genericity follow analytically, not from numerical tests.
scientific_limitations: Reconstruction uses four known calibrated plane frames with shadows up to planar translation only; independent planar rotation or reflection ambiguity, projection-area-only data, and arbitrary convex bodies are not covered. The noise constant is configuration-specific and not optimal. No independent priority certification is claimed.
title: Four calibrated planar shadows suffice for exact reconstruction in the threefold-projection class
